title: sheets-engine theme
description: The look of one presentation. Every key of colors becomes the CSS variable --color-<key>. The engine reads only the semantic keys; a presentation may add more for its own content CSS.

accent-lt.description: Light accent: hovers, selected states, soft tints.

accent.description: Accent: outlines, scrollbar, numbers, decorative shapes. Not for small text on paper.

strong.description: Brand dark: titles, primary buttons, toolbar text. Must read on paper (AA).

display.description: Font family for big numbers and display titles.

title.description: Font family for titles and the editor interface.

css.description: Stylesheets that load the fonts (Google Fonts URLs or local files).

logo.description: Logo in the sidebar (path under public/).

logoMono.description: Small one-colour logo in the sheet footer.

radius.description: Corner radius of the cards, e.g. 0.75rem.

texture.description: Default paper grain over the sheets.

background.description: Backgrounds offered on every card (colours or CSS gradients).

text.description: Text colours in the formatting bar: [colour, name].
